body:
I love pharmaceuticals. One of my favorites is ambien, often prescribed for insomnia. A friend of mine has a scrip for 10 mg, so I bought 2 and 1/2 from him for about 5 bucks.
I had taken one (10 mg) a few months before and felt nothing. This time I wanted to make sure I got my money's worth.
One of the main side effects is moderate to severe amnesia, so I will share anything I can recall, which isn't that much.
I took them around 10:30. About 25 minutes later I felt very at ease. As each minute grew, so did my relaxation. This excited me, because I knew there was more to come. However due to the rate of my drowsiness, I wasn't able to show much excitement. Sometimes when taking pills I get a little worried. But with this, I was so relaxed I didn't really care. As a matter of fact, I didn't care about anything. It was beginning to get hard to fight the sleepiness, so I decided to play some video games.  I was doing so when it really started to kick in. I could hardly focus what I was doing. My vision was so blurry. Everything was moving. I wasn't seeing things, just doubles. Objects kept multiplying. I decided to lay down. I looked at my ceiling, which has a pattern on it. The patterns were moving in one direction. It was wild. The next thing I remember is seeing pictures on my wall coming out at me. I tried to touch them because it felt like I was looking through 3D glasses. Physically I was messed up as well. I lost most of my motor control. I vaguely remember a friend calling. I said 'huh' a million times because I couldn't concentrate. I don't remember anything else from that night. I love this drug and will continue to use recreationally. By the way, a plus is when I woke up the next morning, it was early...and NO drowsiness whatsoever.
